# Penelope Social

> Penelope Social is an Italian restaurant, cafe and bar at 125 Hawkview Blvd in Woodbridge, Vaughan, Ontario. Focaccia sandwiches and Roman-style sourdough pizza at lunch, New York pies and shareables at dinner, and cocktails until late. The bread comes from its sister bakery, Penelope Bakehouse in Scarborough.

## Visit

- Address: 125 Hawkview Blvd, Woodbridge, ON L4H 2E2, Canada (Woodbridge is a community in the City of Vaughan)
- Phone: (905) 607-0606
- Email: info@penelopesocial.com
- Cafe hours: Monday to Saturday 9am to 3pm, Sunday 8am to 12pm
- Bar hours: Monday to Thursday 5pm to 10pm, Friday to Saturday 5pm to 1am
- [Directions on Google Maps](https://www.google.com/maps/dir/?api=1&destination=125+Hawkview+Blvd%2C+Woodbridge%2C+ON+L4H+2E2)

- [All menus](https://penelopesocial.com/menus)

- [Dinner](https://penelopesocial.com/menus/dinner): pizzas, handhelds, shareables

## Specialties

- [Italian focaccia sandwiches in Vaughan](https://penelopesocial.com/sandwiches-vaughan): sourdough focaccia, $19 to $23
- [Sourdough pizza in Vaughan](https://penelopesocial.com/pizza-vaughan): Roman-style slices at lunch, 14-inch pies at dinner
- [Italian cafe in Vaughan](https://penelopesocial.com/cafe-in-vaughan): espresso, cappuccino, Bakehouse pastries from 9am
- [Sourdough bakery in Vaughan](https://penelopesocial.com/bakery-vaughan): loaves, focaccia and pizza dough to take home

## Sister bakery

- [Penelope Bakehouse](https://penelopebakehouse.com): 71 Howden Rd, Scarborough, ON M1R 3C7, (647) 812-0104. Sourdough loaves, focaccia sandwiches and pizza by the slice. A separate shop, not a second Penelope Social dining room.
